objective: Causally compare answer-content and answer-position/symbol information

contrast_types.position: same image and semantic answer, different correct list position and A/B/C/D symbol
contrast_types.content: different visual answer content, same correct list position and A/B/C/D symbol

clean_gate: Both prompts must be behaviorally correct in A/B/C/D; content contrasts must also have correct semantic four-way argmax
primary_metrics: normalized recovery of the contrast-specific readout
